reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I confirmed that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats, which replaces the number he posted this morning. I also told him I don't keep a separate record that gets updated, so his post in #central-random is the correction. If he wants the original message in #central-team fixed, he'll have to edit it himself.

Tobias said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. I didn't read #central-team or look up anything else about the account. Seat counts aren't money terms, and Tobias had already posted the number in this channel, so it was fine to repeat it there.
